item.title: A Generalized Lefschetz Degree with applications to Fixed Point Theory
item.description: arXiv:2611.25132v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We introduce and study a class of spaces, named Lefschetz admissible, where the identity maps on compacts can be approximated by certain maps with values in Lefschetz spaces in a suitable sense. For maps defined on these spaces, we introduce a generalized Lefschetz degree obtained as the set of accumulation points of usual Lefschetz degrees for the approximant maps in a certain compactification. We show that when the degree is nonempty, fixed point results hold. We consider both the situation of spaces embedded in topological vector spaces (TVSs) as global and as neighborhood retracts. As two consequences, we obtain a generalization of a fixed point result due to Browder, and a no-retraction criterion for compact subsets of locally convex TVSs.
item.dc:creator: Emanuele Zappala

item.title: Controlled Riemannian rigidity
item.description: arXiv:2611.10854v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Given a compact Lie group acting smoothly and freely on a compact connected manifold, we prove that the space of invariant Riemannian metrics whose symmetry group is precisely the group in question is open dense in that of all invariant metrics provided the orbit space is at least 2-dimensional. This strengthens the author's prior results to their optimal dimension bound and recovers Ebin's non-equivariant analogue to the effect that trivial-symmetry Riemannian metrics constitute an open dense set. In the process, the discussion also addresses a number of apparent gaps in said sources, pertaining to the rigidity results in question.
item.dc:creator: Alexandru Chirvasitu
